title: API/SDK compact onboarding vignettes for auth, streaming, and tool calls
creator: Maya Patel
description: Design and deliver a set of compact onboarding vignettes and screenshot-ready assets for the API/SDK quickstart docs. Scope covers: 1) authentication & API key setup (web + CLI), 2) streaming generation (server and client examples), 3) tool-calling / function-calling patterns and visual hints for structured output. Goal is 6-8 micro-assets (cards + single-pane screenshots) that can be reused across docs, release blog, and SDK READMEs. Assets must be accessible (alt text, color contrast), production-ready (export presets for 2x/3x PNG, SVG), and come with motion specs for micro-animations used in the interactive quickstart embed.
acceptance_criteria: 6 total assets exported: 3 SVG source files + 6 PNG variants (1x, 2x)
Each asset has descriptive alt text and a 1-sentence caption for docs use
Figma file with labeled components and tokens published to team library
Motion spec sheet (timing, easing, keyframes) included as comment in Figma and exported PDF
Hand-off checklist completed and link to PR for docs page that uses the assets
deliverables: Auth card: web console key creation + CLI snippet (compact, single-column screenshot)
Key rotation flow: small flow diagram (SVG) showing rotate -> update -> fallback steps
Streaming card: client streaming flow with progress indicator (animated prototype)
Tool-calling example: structured output card with schema hints and sample JSON result
Assets zip package: SVGs, PNGs, alt-text .csv, motion-spec PDF
Figma link and published component library entry
